column2: This sheet provides calculations and logic required to determine distance between the user input CO2 point source location and every viable potential CO2 storage (saline and EOR) field's geographic centroid location, as well as the FYBE cost of CO2 transport and storage for every viable potential CO2 storage location, following all user inputs.  The CTS tool finds the lowest cost T&S option based on the calculations in this sheet.

column27: CTS Tool Utility: Storage Lookup Key

column1: Storage Project Type (SALINE = saline aquifer; EOR = conventional oilfield converted to CO2 Enhanced Oil Revocery)
column2: The unique identifying number aligns to CO2_S_COM geologic database formations, and CO2 EOR Evaluation System oilfields
column3: The basin name is based on USGS oil and gas province names, used for conventional oilfields
column4: aligns to CO2_S_COM geologic database formations; the numbers refer to defined portions of the overall reservoir
column5: U.S. state abbreviation where the formation centroid is located
column6: Saline formation or Basin - State (oilfield proxy) geographic centroid longitude
column7: Saline formation or Basin - State (oilfield proxy) geographic centroid latitude
column9: latitude; decimal degrees (based on user source location input)
column10: longitude; decimal degrees (based on user source location input)
column11: straight-line distance between point source and formation centroid, in miles, accounting for curvature of the earth
column12: distance between point source and formation centroid, rounded to nearest 10 miles, accounting for user input tortuosity
column13: CO2_T_COM FYBE cost, adjusted to user selected cost basis year
column14: number of parallel trunklines selected by user (1, 2, or 3); default is 1 if dedicated pipeline option is selected by user
column15: pipeline distance between point source and trunkline, if selected; 1/10th the length of the trunkline, maximum of 50 miles
column16: CO2_T_COM FYBE cost of gathering pipeline, if trunkline option is selected by user
column17: pipeline distance between trunkline and storage site, if trunkline selected; 1/10th the length of the trunkline, maximum of 50 miles
column18: CO2_T_COM FYBE cost of distribution pipeline, if trunkline option is selected by user
column19: Total Transport cost, for all estimated distances below 1000 miles.  CTS tool assumes pipelines over 1000 miles are not tenable.
column20: Post Injection Site Care duration in years based on user selection, for saline storage projects
column21: Flag whether the conventional oilfield is near the end of secondary (waterflood) recovery and could be likely to economically transition to tertiary (EOR) recovery, based on original and current oil in place estimates
column22: CO2_S_COM FYBE cost of storage; or CO2 EOR Evaluation System FYBE price of CO2
column23: Flag whether the saline formation or conventional oilfield has adequate CO2 storage capacity, accounting for pressure interference, for 30 years of storage at user selected injection rate
column24: Combined Transport and Storage FYBE cost, from Co2 source's perspective, if appropraite flags are "Yes" and transportation distance is <1000 miles
column25: The unique identifying number aligns to CO2_S_COM geologic database formations, and CO2 EOR Evaluation System oilfields, repeated for CTS tool lookup functionality
